# Pixel Date Calculator

An offline date calculator made with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Choose two dates to see the absolute calendar-day distance, the number of full weeks within that distance, and whether the second date is before or after the first. Matching dates show “Same day.”

## Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server, installation, or internet connection is required.
